The JTB picture with only Knowledge and Belief as resources for justification runs straight into the classic regress/terminus dilemma.

The alternative to letting the regress run forever is to stop the chain at some point and say that certain beliefs are justified simply in virtue of being held, i.e., to posit a class of basic or foundational beliefs that are taken as epistemically given.

On a strictly belief/knowledge-only inventory that stopping point is just dogmatism: you end up with beliefs that are treated as justified even though they themselves enjoy no independent justification within the system, an arbitrary foundation for the rest of the justificatory structure.

If you try to avoid the regress you are left with having to stop the chain at some point. But the only states you have are Knowledge, which by definition already requires justification, and Belief, which by itself is not knowledge. So the stopping point can only be an unjustified but taken-for-granted belief. That is the problem of an arbitrary or dogmatic foundation

With JTB as K = B ∧ T ∧ J and K entails B, the only non-knowledge bin you have left is ‘Belief’. That bin is forced to be the logical complement of K, i.e. ... so Belief has to do the work of three distinct epistemic profiles at once.
I think we can get the two pressures more clearly if we stay with the 2×2 Truth × Justification space that JTB is trying to supervise, and ask what a Knowledge/Belief only ontology can still mark.

With only Knowledge = JTB and Belief as the residual non-knowledge category, the two-dimensional space Truth x Justification is forced into a Knowledge/Belief dichotomy and Belief becomes a heterogeneous grab-bag.
That is why JTB on a two-state inventory faces the regress problem together with the problem of having to appeal to unjustified, essentially dogmatic foundations to block the regress.

If the justification for a belief P has to be provided by a further epistemic state that is either a case of Knowledge or a mere Belief, the only way to avoid appealing to something outside the inventory is to let beliefs justify beliefs. That quickly makes any putative Knowledge P depend on some other belief Q, which in turn needs its own justification in belief R, and so on. The only way to close the chain without leaving the inventory is for the chain to loop back on itself: P is justified by Q, Q by R, ... and R by P.
On a demanding reading where the justifier itself must be known, you never actually get off the ground without an infinite chain of justifiers.

Patton’s famously explosive temper was accompanied by a distinct physical tic that contemporaries noted. He took a facial shrapnel wound in the fighting around the Meuse-Argonne in 1918 that never fully healed, leaving a small nerve/soft-tissue defect in his cheek. The pan-American propagule rain therefore raises the effective immigration rescue at the high latitude, low-m end disproportionately and acts as a homogenising flux along the transect. Beta diversity falls as the same common neutral element is sampled at essentially the same frequency everywhere.
